description: This file defines the base class 'Image_Graph_Common' which provides common functionality for graph creation classes in the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for managing sub-elements, parent relationships, canvas output, and error handling.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Common
classes.description: A base class providing common functionality for all Image_Graph classes, including element management, parent/child relationships, and output handling.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets all sub-elements, calling their _reset methods.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object and updates the canvas reference.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the element by setting its visibility to false.

methods.name: _getCanvas
methods.description: Retrieves the canvas object, either from the current object or its parent.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an existing element to the sub-elements list and sets its parent.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Creates a new object of a specified class and adds it to the sub-elements list.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Displays an error message on the canvas.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes output to the canvas, invoking done() on sub-elements.
